notes: AXIM Phase Gate 2026-07-25: the OPT SIGNALS provider audit is COMPLETE and now the frozen baseline, not an ongoing activity. Do not restart, repeat, or expand this provider audit. Only revalidate a provider when a parser, normalization, assembler, replay-engine, or routing change directly affects it (see docs/opt_signals_gap_queue.md for the smart-revalidation trigger list). parser_readiness (VERIFIED/PARTIALLY_VERIFIED/BLOCKED) measures ONLY whether AXIM can correctly interpret this provider's signals through the production pipeline - it must never be reduced by operational configuration. operational_status (LIVE/DEMO/OBSERVATION_ONLY/DISABLED/NOT_ASSIGNED) measures ONLY whether AXIM should currently execute trades from this provider. graduation_stage tracks lifecycle position: DISCOVERED -> PROFILED -> REPLAY_VALIDATED -> PARSER_VERIFIED -> OBSERVATION_MODE -> DEMO_VERIFIED -> LIVE_VERIFIED. See docs/opt_signals_capability_matrix.md for the cross-provider capability baseline and docs/opt_signals_engineering_dashboard.md for the consolidated summary. Regression fixtures (tests/fixtures/provider_corpus.py) are permanent and must never be deleted.

sources.adapter_parser: none - no adapter exists for this bot's inline-keyboard callback flow
sources.correctly_assembled: n/a - AXIM has never driven this bot's button flow, only observed a human doing so historically
sources.remaining_blocker: Exact interaction sequence observed in real history: /start -> bot intro (4 fixed messages) -> MANDATORY registration of a NEW Pocket Option account via the bot's own referral link (https://trading-booster.rocks/register) -> user replies with new account ID as plain text -> bot requires a REAL DEPOSIT of $50+ into that new account before it will proceed -> bot presents an inline keyboard to pick a currency pair (callback button, e.g. 'Choose a trading pair:') -> inline keyboard to pick expiry -> ~15s fake 'analysis' -> bot emits one CALL/PUT signal with asset+direction+probability stats (no explicit expiry echoed in the text itself). This is NOT a passive/unsolicited signal push - a signal only appears after a live human presses two sequential inline-keyboard buttons. AXIM has no adapter or automation for driving Telegram inline-keyboard callback_query buttons for this bot, and none should be built casually: consuming this source would require creating a brand-new Pocket Option account outside AXIM's existing broker-account model and funding it with a real deposit, which is a real-money authorization decision reserved for the user, not an engineering gap to close silently. UPDATE 2026-07-25: passive button-structure capture now exists (core/telegram_listener.py's _serialize_buttons, channel_messages.buttons_json) for any future interaction, but this does not change the core blocker. Precise blocker: (1) no callback-button-driving adapter exists, (2) even if built, using it requires new-account creation + real deposit that needs explicit user authorization first.

sources.title: Trading Booster Elite Membership
sources.adapter_parser: generic signal_assembler + parsers.signal_parser (line-scoped direction search fixes the false positive) - still INCOMPATIBLE with this provider's session-scoped announcement/result-echo vocabulary, see blocker
sources.false_positives: 0 after fix (was 1 before: message [51781]'s session-opening narrative, see below - same shared-parser fix as Daniel FX Trade/TYLER VIP CLUB)
sources.edits_handled: n/a - no edits observed in history
sources.cancellations_handled: n/a - no cancellations observed in history
sources.remaining_blocker: Real format: each session opens with a labeled block ('Pair: GBPUSD\nExpiration: 2 minute\nCandles: 30 seconds') followed by free-text market commentary; individual trades are bare direction-only posts ('\ud83d\udeab PUT (Low!)' / '\ud83d\udeab CALL (High!)'); the platform echoes each trade's outcome as 'GBPUSD \u2705'/'\u274c' (pair name + check/cross, NOT a new announcement); mid-session pair switches are announced only as free text ('We change the pair to EURCAD'); sessions close with a free-text wrap-up including balance figures. RESOLVED 2026-07-25: the FALSE POSITIVE on message [51781] (session-2 opening narrative parsed as a phantom AUD/CAD SELL signal purely from the incidental word 'sell' in prose) is fixed by the shared line-scoped direction-search change in parsers/signal_parser.py - confirmed via replay, this channel's signal_ready count dropped from 9 to 8 with the phantom signal correctly reclassified as no_signal, zero other change. STILL UNRESOLVED: (1) MISSED SIGNALS - because this channel's own asset/expiry announcement block is never recognized as an announcement (no adapter for it) and 'GBPUSD \u2705'/'\u274c' result-echoes are misread as fresh bare-asset announcements (harmless only by coincidence, since they happen to repeat the currently-correct pair name), the assembler's normal 300-second pending-signal timeout is repeatedly exceeded during this provider's real 7-12 minute gaps between trades, silently dropping at least 6 of the 15 real trade signals in this history (e.g. [50851], [51095], [51788], [51834], [51918], [51960], [52062]). (2) 'We change the pair to X' mid-session pair switches are never recognized at all, so the carried asset is never correctly updated by that message (only accidentally corrected later by the next result-echo, if the assembly window hasn't already expired). Fixing this provider properly requires real new adapter work - not a one-line patch: recognizing this provider's specific announcement/result-echo/pair-change vocabulary, and giving it a session-scoped carried-asset lifetime instead of the short per-signal assembly timeout (see docs/opt_signals_gap_queue.md item 4). Channel is disabled, never onboarded, no Fund/broker assignment - zero live risk today. Raw message IDs 50825-52092 preserved in channel_messages for future replay.
sources.graduation_stage_note: full replay performed against real history; confirmed false-positive + missed-signal gaps mean it has not cleared the PARSER_VERIFIED gate
